audit.why: EVEN 6/10 matches 50.32% over 1240 games and matches the mirror (audits/top/zac__renekton): Renekton owns 2-3 and the first-item window, Zac owns the late teamfight.

audit.whatIsWrong: The 2+ items row said Renekton on both layers while the packet chart says Skill and whys[6] says he becomes a teamfight initiator you should avoid.
audit.why: Packet levelChart[6] is 'Skill'. Level 6 is already Skill on both layers, which agrees with the packet and with the mirror.
audit.corrected: 2+ items to Skill on both layers with phases[6].why restated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 advice is backwards, and the passive is given a fabricated name 'They Will Not Feast'.
audit.why: Reusing the mirror's finding from the Zac side: Dominus grants Renekton bonus Health for its duration, and Unstable Matter (W, flat 5s) deals a percentage of your MAXIMUM health — so popping your ult raises the damage his W does to you. The page treats Dominus as a pure buffer against his level-6 window. The passive is Cell Division: it sheds reabsorbable chunks and revives him from bloblets on fatal damage — that revive is why anti-heal and clearing blobs matter more than raw armour.
audit.corrected: State the Dominus/Unstable Matter interaction and name Cell Division.

audit.whatIsWrong: Elastic Slingshot is the tracked cooldown on every page section and its number appears nowhere.
audit.why: 21/18/15/12/9 seconds — at rank 1 a whiffed Slingshot buys you a 21-second window, which is the single most punishable cooldown in the lane. Let's Bounce! is 120/105/90.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Zac carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: he is a teamfight initiator with Sunfire durability. Zac carry threat 7/10 — side-lane, never fight near his team.

edits.before: Zac cannot match your short-trade burst at levels 4-5 and his Elastic Slingshot is a telegraph, not a gap-closer — punish every whiff with a full E-W-Q rotation.
edits.after: Zac cannot match your short-trade burst at 4-5 and Elastic Slingshot is a 21s wind-up at rank 1 — punish every whiff with the full E-W-Q rotation.

edits.before: His R (Let's Bounce) comes online and can absorb your first engage with a hard knockup — activate Dominus just before impact so the HP buffer covers the CC window.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! knocks up on every bounce, but note Dominus adds bonus Health and Unstable Matter takes a percentage of it — anti-heal first, then commit.

edits.before: Zac's R (Let's Bounce) threatens a hard-knockup all-in — respect it on cooldown or you hand him a free kill through the stun chain.
edits.after: Let's Bounce! is 120s at rank 1 and knocks up on each of its four bounces — punish the whole window once he has spent it.

edits.before: Step on his passive blobs (They Will Not Feast) immediately after every trade to cut off his HP regeneration
edits.after: Step on his passive blobs (Cell Division) immediately after every trade to cut off his HP regeneration

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — sidestep the wind-up and punish.

edits.before: Track Zac's Elastic Slingshot: His engage. Bait it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Unstable Matter takes percent max health every 5s — the bonus HP from Dominus feeds it.

notes: Mirror reused rather than re-researched — the Zac-side audit's Dominus/Unstable Matter finding is restated here from Renekton's perspective, and my ratings and chart stay consistent with it. 'They Will Not Feast' was a fabricated passive name; the passive is Cell Division. FLAG MISFIRE: Zac's E carries a 'grounding' flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description ('attaches his arms to the ground and stretches back, launching himself forward') says nothing about grounding, so I did NOT write that Elastic Slingshot denies your Slice and Dice — per the rules I trusted the description over the flag.
